changes: Recovered private conversation intake, bounded vocabulary generation and the complete release-74 records.
Preview aliases preserve all existing robots directives and never forward writes, even when canonical hosts allow them.

Added explicit keyring binding for unattended Ollama search and a bounded separate-network acceptance observer. The first long scheduler activation exposed a separate helper-timeout incompatibility; that repair is the next candidate.

cloudflare.compatibility_scope: Skips only the browser-header heuristic on known Baltor hosts for GET/HEAD and the declared API/MCP paths. Managed WAF, DDoS protection and application authentication/rate controls remain selected.
cloudflare.rollback: Set the recorded documentation DNS record back to proxied=false; retain the Worker, route and all source objects.

retained_failed_attempts: Default Python user agents were refused before reaching the application. The bounded agent-compatibility rule repaired this, and the owner catalogue and all-host pulse then passed.

The first documentation browser run passed 200 of 201 checks. Cloudflare legitimately omitted Content-Length for compressed HEAD responses. Explicit identity-encoding probes preserve the strict byte-length check and pass; the next checker source carries that request correction.
The first peer run finished before the successful local flood. A second run deliberately overlapped both networks and passed.

The first 20-minute keyring-wrapped scheduler invocation was refused by the general operator CLI's 300-second cap. A supervised two-minute proof passed with 29 real Ollama searches. The public-lane scheduler was restored while the fixed long-pass wrapper is reviewed.

limits: R2 mirroring remains supervised and incomplete; production bodies and custom search remain on Fly.
Personalized feeds, the two-offering interface and a paid feed-only plan are not activated by this revision.
